entries.name: Accelerating Gravitational N-Body Simulations on Tenstorrent Wormhole
entries.description: Accelerates an astrophysical N-body simulation on the Wormhole n300. Achieves 2× speedup and 2× energy savings over a highly optimized CPU implementation. SC '25 Workshop.

entries.name: Numerical Kernels on a Spatial Accelerator: Tenstorrent Wormhole
entries.description: Implements three numerical kernels and composes them into a conjugate gradient solver on Wormhole. Demonstrates AI accelerators merit consideration for HPC workloads traditionally dominated by CPUs and GPUs. 2026.

entries.name: Collective Operations on Wormhole n150 (Sapienza University of Rome)
entries.description: Master's thesis implementing and benchmarking five allreduce algorithms (Swing, Recursive Doubling, Bandwidth Optimal, Latency Optimal, Shared Memory) on the Wormhole n150. Bandwidth Optimal achieved best performance, approaching within 2× of theoretical optimal.
entries.author: Charles Heron (Sapienza University of Rome)

entries.name: Accelerating Stencils on the Tenstorrent Grayskull RISC-V Accelerator
entries.description: Explores stencil computation on the Grayskull PCIe RISC-V accelerator. Early academic work examining TT hardware for HPC stencil workloads. 2024.

entries.name: Stencil Computations on Tenstorrent Wormhole
entries.description: Maps 2D 5-point stencil computations onto the Tenstorrent Wormhole RISC-V AI dataflow accelerator via two implementations: element-wise decomposition (Axpy) and matrix-multiplication reformulation (MatMul). Profiling shows the isolated Wormhole kernel is competitive with CPU execution, with PCIe transfers and initialization driving end-to-end overhead; Axpy achieves lower energy than the CPU baseline at large scales. Identifies architectural and software directions for making AI accelerators viable for HPC stencil workloads. 2025.

entries.name: SwiftNPU: Scalable Shape-Flexible Allocation for Inter-Core Connected NPUs
entries.description: Makes multi-tenant NPU sharing practical for Blackhole-class hardware using polynomial-time allocation algorithms. Delivers up to 1.37× higher utilization and 1.14× faster workload completion. Up to 890,000× faster than NP-hard baselines.

entries.name: TileLoom: Automatic Dataflow Planning for Spatial Dataflow Accelerators
entries.description: Compiler system that automatically generates efficient dataflow plans for tile-based languages on spatial accelerators including Tenstorrent Wormhole. Exploits on-chip network forwarding between processing elements to reduce DRAM pressure.
entries.author: Wei Li, Zhenyu Bai, Heru Wang, Pranav Dangi

entries.name: Rewriting TTS Inference Economics: Lightning V2 on Tenstorrent vs. NVIDIA L40S
entries.description: Shows that Text-to-Speech inference on Tenstorrent Lightning V2 achieves 4× lower cost than NVIDIA L40S. Applies BlockFloat8 (BFP8) and low-fidelity (LoFi) precision strategies to TTS despite their greater numerical fragility compared to LLMs.
entries.author: Ranjith M. S., Akshat Mandloi, Sudarshan Kamath

entries.name: TT-GoL
entries.description: Conway's Game of Life implemented on Tenstorrent hardware using TT-Metal kernels.
entries.author: JushBJJ

entries.name: ttMandelbrot
entries.description: Mandelbrot Set fractal renderer running on Tenstorrent hardware. A classic demo showcasing parallel compute on Tensix cores.
entries.author: marty1885

entries.name: tt-twitch
entries.description: A Tenstorrent Grayskull kernel written live on Twitch by George Hotz. 120-core grid demonstration of live kernel programming.
entries.author: geohot

entries.name: tt-zork-and-more
entries.description: A Tenstorrent fork of Infocom's Zork I (and more!), running a Z-machine interpreter at least four different ways on TT hardware. The most fun you can have with an AI accelerator.
entries.author: tsingletaryTT

entries.name: Tenstorrent Cookbook: Particle Life Simulator
entries.description: Particle Life simulation on Tenstorrent hardware — an emergent-behavior N-body system where simple attraction/repulsion rules between species produce complex lifelike patterns. Cookbook recipe demonstrating parallel N-body compute on Tensix.
entries.author: tsingletaryTT

entries.name: tt-claw
entries.description: A Tenstorrent-powered claw machine that rewards players with real prizes. The QuietBox 2 runs local AI inference to act as an agent controlling the claw hardware — the OpenClaw AI assistant lesson builds directly on this project.
entries.author: tsingletaryTT

entries.name: diamond
entries.description: DIAMOND: Atari game-playing agent implemented on Tenstorrent hardware via tt-lang. Diffusion-based world model for reinforcement learning.
entries.author: zoecarver

entries.name: tt-forge-compiletron
entries.description: Compile more than 100 models on tt-forge in a display format suitable for demos. Comprehensive showcase of tt-forge model compatibility.
entries.author: tsingletaryTT

entries.name: Tenstorrent Cookbook: Conway's Game of Life
entries.description: TT-Metalium implementation of Conway's Game of Life as a cookbook recipe. Each generation is a full parallel kernel dispatch over the grid — a clean introduction to stateful compute on Tensix cores.

links.label: Cookbook Recipe 1: Conway's Game of Life

entries.name: tt-qb-lights
entries.description: Sync your Tenstorrent Quietbox's RGB lighting to accelerator utilization status. Visual feedback for hardware activity in real time.
entries.author: tsingletaryTT

entries.name: Programming Tenstorrent Processors
entries.description: Deep-dive into the Tenstorrent architecture and Metalium programming model — circular buffers, kernel synchronization, NoC routing, and where the footguns are. The honest guide to thinking in Tensix.
entries.author: Martin Chang

entries.name: Tenstorrent Blackhole Architecture Guide
entries.description: A 6,500-word community deep dive into the Blackhole p100a architecture: the tile model (Tensix, DRAM, SiFive x280 L2CPU, Ethernet, PCIe, NoC arc), firmware startup sequence, MOP micro-op processor, replay buffer, FPU/SFPU sync, and the anatomy of a kernel. From the author of blackhole-py.
entries.author: boopdotpng

entries.name: A Gentle Guide: Tenstorrent Card on Arch Linux with Metalium
entries.description: Step-by-step guide to getting a Tenstorrent card running on Arch Linux with the full Metalium stack. Practical troubleshooting from someone who did it the hard way first.
entries.author: Martin Chang

entries.name: Thoughts and Logs After Messing with Tenstorrent Grayskull
entries.description: Honest field notes from getting a Grayskull card running and writing first Metalium kernels. Covers setup pitfalls, processor hangs, memory protection quirks, and what makes Metalium compelling despite early rough edges.
entries.author: Martin Chang

entries.name: Tenstorrent Architecture — W&M CSCI654 Advanced Computer Architecture
entries.description: Lecture 20 from William & Mary's graduate Computer Architecture course. Frames Tenstorrent in the landscape between GPUs and TPUs, draws comparisons to Cerebras and SambaNova, then dives deep into the Wormhole chip and Tensix core: the 5 RISC-V core design, SFPU, NoC, and dataflow execution model.
entries.author: Yifan & GPU / William & Mary

entries.name: TT-Metal Mini Template
entries.description: Minimal working CMake project template for starting a new TT-Metal project from scratch. Good starting point for community kernel development.
entries.author: JushBJJ

entries.name: tt-tutorial (HPC)
entries.description: Tutorial on Tenstorrent hardware for HPC researchers from the RISC-V Testbed project at Edinburgh/EPCC. Covers Wormhole from an HPC parallel-computing perspective.
entries.author: RISCVtestbed

entries.name: tt-tutorial (Korean)
entries.description: Comprehensive tutorials for the Tenstorrent software stack in Korean. Jupyter notebooks covering the full developer path from hardware setup to model inference.
entries.author: changh95

entries.name: tenstorrent-tiny-examples
entries.description: Simple C++ kernel experiments on a GraySkull e75 chip. Hands-on examples for learning the TT-Metal programming model at the metal level.
entries.author: jaebaek

entries.name: ttnn-helloworld-cpp
entries.description: Minimal working example of using Tenstorrent TTNN in C++. The simplest possible starting point for C++ developers targeting TT hardware with TTNN.
entries.author: marty1885

entries.name: ttVecAdd
entries.description: Minimal vector-addition example on Tenstorrent devices using TT-Metalium. A clean hello-world for the TT-Metal kernel programming model in C++.
entries.author: marty1885

entries.name: CS Fundamentals on Tenstorrent Hardware
entries.description: Seven-module computer science curriculum taught on real Tenstorrent hardware. Covers RISC-V architecture, memory hierarchy, parallel computing, networks and NoC, synchronization, abstraction layers, and computational complexity — all grounded in what is physically happening on the chip.
entries.author: tsingletaryTT

entries.name: Custom Model Training on Tenstorrent
entries.description: Eight-lesson series covering the full custom training workflow on TT hardware: dataset fundamentals, configuration patterns, fine-tuning, multi-device distributed training, experiment tracking, model architecture basics, and training from scratch.
entries.author: tsingletaryTT

entries.name: Tenstorrent Cookbook: Core Recipes
entries.description: Three hands-on TT-Metalium kernel recipes: a Mandelbrot fractal explorer, real-time audio signal processing pipeline, and custom image filter stack. Each recipe is a complete kernel project with full source in the lesson.
entries.author: tsingletaryTT

entries.name: tt-vscode-toolkit
entries.description: 48 interactive lessons covering the full Tenstorrent developer path — from hardware detection to custom training — with click-to-run commands and hardware auto-detection. Available in VSCode and code-server.

entries.name: tt-installer
entries.description: Install the complete Tenstorrent software stack with one command. Handles drivers, firmware, Python environment, and SDK setup automatically.
